title: Homology of Free-Lie Current Algebras over Square-Zero Extensions
statement: Let $E$ and $V$ be finite-dimensional complex vector spaces, let $A=\mathbb C\oplus E$ with $E^2=0$, and let $\mathfrak g=\operatorname{Lie}(V)$ be the free Lie algebra. Determine the Lie algebra homology $H_*(\mathfrak g\otimes A)$, preferably as a sum of polynomial functors in $E$ and $V$.

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** General formulas exist for important low-degree cases of current Lie-algebra homology, but no general computation of H_*(g tensor A) for the stated broad class is available.

**Sources checked.**

- [Zusmanovich, current Lie algebras](https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.0217)
